card.name: Starting dosage in dosing sections
card.fires_on: The word dosage or dose right after words like recommended, starting, initial or lower, in the dosage and administration part of a drug label. It sits just before the amount is given.

modes.label: Starting dosage
modes.description: The word dosage or dose follows recommended, starting or initial, just before the first amount.
modes.example: For children and adolescents new to methylphenidate, the recommended starting<< dosage>> is 18 mg once daily.

modes.label: Dosage heading
modes.description: The first part of the word dosage inside a heading such as Recommended Dosage.

modes.label: Titrate or lower dose
modes.description: Dose or dosage follows a verb or adjective that signals adjusting the amount.
